title: Precision at Scale: Domain-Specific Datasets On-Demand
abstract: arXiv:2407.03463v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In the realm of self-supervised learning (SSL), conventional wisdom has gravitated towards the utility of massive, general domain datasets for pretraining robust backbones. In this paper, we challenge this idea by exploring if it is possible to bridge the scale between general-domain datasets and (traditionally smaller) domain-specific datasets to reduce the current performance gap. More specifically, we propose Precision at Scale (PaS), a novel method for the autonomous creation of domain-specific datasets on-demand. The modularity of the PaS pipeline enables leveraging state-of-the-art foundational and generative models to create a collection of images of any given size belonging to any given domain with minimal human intervention. translated_title: 规模化精度：按需生成的领域特定数据集
translated_abstract: 在自监督学习（SSL）领域，传统观点一直倾向于使用大规模、通用领域的数据集来预训练鲁棒的骨干网络。本文挑战了这一观点，探讨了是否有可能弥合通用领域数据集与（传统上规模较小的）领域特定数据集之间的规模差距，以缩小目前的性能差距。更具体地说，我们提出了规模化精度方法，这是一种按需自主创建领域特定数据集的新方法。PaS流水线的模块化特性使其能够利用最先进的基础模型和生成模型，以最少的人工干预创建属于任意给定领域、任意给定规模的图像集合。在两个复杂领域中的广泛分析证明了PaS数据集在多样性、规模以及训练视觉模型的有效性方面均优于现有的传统领域特定数据集。
tldr: 本文提出PaS方法，通过模块化流水线利用先进的基础模型和生成模型按需自动构建任意领域、任意规模的领域特定数据集，在多样性、规模和训练有效性上超越传统领域特定数据集，从而弥合通用数据集与领域特定数据集之间的性能差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Precision at Scale (PaS), a novel method that autonomously creates domain-specific datasets on-demand by leveraging state-of-the-art foundational and generative models with minimal human intervention, demonstrating superior diversity, scale, and pretraining effectiveness compared to traditional domain-specific datasets.
